trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.desc: Earn every other trophy in GTA VI single-player.
trophies.guide: This unlocks on its own once the other 54 are done. No multiplayer or DLC is needed, so treat it as the finish line rather than a goal to chase directly.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy from the opening mission in Chapter 1. It pops automatically as you play through the first mission, so there is nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded when you finish the first chapter. The pop can arrive a little late, after the first mission or two of Chapter 2, which is normal.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish the second chapter. Like the other chapter trophies it may pop slightly after the chapter boundary, once the next chapter's opening missions are done.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish the third chapter. Automatic and unmissable; just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the fourth chapter. It unlocks automatically as the story moves into Chapter 5.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the last story mission in Chapter 5. This is the gold story trophy and the last one the campaign hands you.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A Chapter 2 story mission. Play through it and the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A Chapter 3 story mission. Automatic once the heist mission is finished.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 story mission. It unlocks when the mission is complete.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 story mission. Automatic on completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 story mission. Automatic on completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A Chapter 5 story mission. Automatic on completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open the checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story. It is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: you need 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 300 of 397 stunts. Robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, mixing stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. Track progress by region in the Progress menu.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do one of each of the 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Most happen naturally during the story and map cleanup.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 range challenges across 12 ranges. Gold each one; the tracker shows which remain. Focus and steady aim matter more than speed.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at all 14 locations, 42 races in total. Learn each course's corners, then run clean laps.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct race events. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the easiest circuits and repeat wins there.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After meeting Cal in Chapter 1 he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento. Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four in-game video games end to end. Three play on the TV at home; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end, not every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia only. Andy calls during Chapter 3 and texts her address in Belville. Finish her five quests, the Cellerica chain, the fee, the initiation, the van and the warehouse meet, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand starts in Chapter 1. Dive for his treasures at 7 shipwrecks and bring them back. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapter 2 or 3, so nothing is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain stranger strands count. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed. Others like Moses or Andy do not count. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's wish list opens in Chapter 3 after you steal the Zorrusso for him. Deliver the 16 sports cars he wants; scanning a car with WAiNK tells you if it is on the list. Deliveries in good condition pay more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason only. Tyrone's strand opens in Chapter 3 after Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the synthetic labs marked in Vice City, then finish his second quest to shut the labs down.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts twice. THE ONE TO PROTECT: in Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house, Lucia talks about meditating and walks to the balcony. Follow her, talk to her and choose Accept. That meditation vanishes after Chapter 1 and may be required.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason only. Bret texts Jason after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. Clearing his 15 target decks, which the 100% checklist needs anyway, should cover it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: There are 18 card sets around Leonida. Finish any 3 sets; the 100% checklist needs 15, so you will likely pass 3 on the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count. There are far more than 100, so scan whatever you pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops naturally while you work toward that.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Available once Jason and Lucia can roam together after Coffee Break. Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner alongside, then escape the red heat zone. A fast motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, hit 3 shops in a row while keeping the flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring armor, sticky bombs and healing. The pop comes about 30 seconds after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app. Just point and scan, no need to drive them. A busy road gives you dozens quickly. The 100% checklist needs 200, so this comes first.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus while aiming, then drop 5 enemies in one use. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, and pick a spot with clustered gang members. Soldiers, police and civilians do not seem to count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport, the E3/E4 gate is easiest. Drive it back to the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away. It must be a plane connected to a boarding bridge.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station on the island in the southwest. Drive through the gate, climb in, and shoot until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun. Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave quietly.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank jobs open through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is. Follow a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it with your partner, then escape the 4-star heat on a fast bike. Any 5 of the 8 vaults count.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The first bank job counts as an armored truck robbery. You can also do it earlier by blocking a truck near a bank and blowing its back door with a sticky bomb, then escaping the heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the entire map. A plane is fastest. Fly over every blacked-out area until the whole map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal operations. Rob just one operation per gang for this trophy; the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it comes on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it beside the bar for the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After getting the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the window. Only that Banshee counts.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway, code 0300 or sticky bombs. The robbery respawns later if you miss one.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out together. While one trains, the other progresses too. Fitness clubs are marked under Map, Activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. It builds passively through robberies and fights; turn on criminal profile notifications in the UI settings to watch the count.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: In the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store. Return later in the game and rob the same store again as Lucia.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.desc: Unconfirmed. Linked to a suspected UFO questline.
trophies.guide: Guide writers suspect a UFO questline, but nothing is confirmed yet. Watch for stranger encounters and odd signals around Leonida after the story.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Melee attack from a moving vehicle.
trophies.guide: Land a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The in-game hint points to a kick from a motorcycle. Build speed, pull alongside a target and kick.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences.
trophies.guide: Marked bills pile up from robberies. Launder $250,000 total through fences; the dye pack jammer from a Chapter 3 main mission makes it possible. It adds up across jobs.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos add up fastest. Bank vaults are the best late-game earner if you need cash.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages, about $160,000 total. The real estate app arrives in Chapter 2. Garages also give you space for the Scooter Bros registrations.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with buying the garages.
